Added

  • **Insulation and thermal engineering hub** (`hub => heat`) — preliminary thermal-protection checks (SP 50.13330.2012):
  • New hub label `Insulation and thermal engineering` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • **Engineering systems hub** (`hub => engineering`) — preliminary sizing of home systems:
  • New hub label `Engineering systems` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • **Windows, doors and openings hub** (`hub => openings`) — sizing and checking openings:
  • New hub label `Windows, doors and openings` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • **Outbuildings hub** (`hub => outbuildings`) — sizing garden and yard structures:
  • New hub label `Outbuildings` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
